extDescription.message: Form autofill and passkeys with RDVAULT (requires the desktop app)
extDescription.description: Extension description (Chrome Web Store, at most 132 characters)

popupInfoRequiresDesktop.message: This extension requires the RDVAULT app to be running and unlocked.

popupDesktopUnavailable.description: Popup status: the desktop app cannot be reached

popupDesktopNotConnected.message: Desktop app running but not connected
popupDesktopNotConnected.description: Popup status: the desktop app runs but no user is connected

popupDesktopConnected.description: Popup status: connected to the desktop app

popupUserLabel.description: Popup: label before the user name (a space is added after it)

popupServerLabel.description: Popup: label before the server address (a space is added after it)

popupUnknown.description: Popup: unknown user name or server

popupPairingPendingTitle.message: Confirm access in the RDVAULT app
popupPairingPendingTitle.description: Popup status: pairing request waiting for approval in the desktop app

popupPairingPendingDetail.message: A pairing request was sent to RDVAULT. Accept it in the app (within 60 seconds) to enable autofill.
popupPairingPendingDetail.description: Popup: explanation while the pairing request is pending

popupPairingDeniedTitle.description: Popup status: pairing was denied in the desktop app

popupPairingDeniedDetail.message: Pairing for this extension was denied in the app. You can send a new request in one minute.
popupPairingDeniedDetail.description: Popup: explanation after the pairing was denied

popupPairingExpiredTitle.message: Pairing request expired: reopen the extension to try again

popupPairingExpiredDetail.message: The request received no answer in RDVAULT (time limit: 60 seconds). Close and reopen this window to send a new request.

popupDisconnectedDetail.message: Start the desktop app and sign in to use autofill.
popupDisconnectedDetail.description: Popup: how to enable autofill when the desktop app is not connected

autofillIconTitle.description: Tooltip of the icon shown in login fields

autofillHeader.description: Autofill menu header (displayed in upper case)

autofillNoResults.message: No logins found for this site
autofillNoResults.description: Autofill menu: no saved login matches this site

autofillUnnamed.description: Autofill menu: entry without a name

autofillNoUsername.description: Autofill menu: entry without a username

autofillLoading.description: Autofill menu: the selected login is being retrieved

autofillFetchFailed.description: Autofill menu: the selected login could not be retrieved

pkCreateTitle.description: Passkey window: creation request; $HOST$ is the site (relying party) domain

pkCreateOk.description: Passkey window: button that creates the passkey in RDVAULT

pkGetTitle.description: Passkey window: sign-in request; $HOST$ is the site (relying party) domain

pkGetOk.description: Passkey window: button that signs in with the RDVAULT passkey

pkChooseAccount.description: Passkey window: several accounts, the user must pick one (shown after a dash)

pkUseAnotherDevice.description: Passkey window: hand over to the browser's own authenticator (Windows Hello, security key, phone)

pkBlockedWarning.message: Action blocked: the RDVAULT window is hidden or covered by the page. Use “$OTHER$” or “$CANCEL$”.
pkBlockedWarning.description: Passkey window: anti-clickjacking warning; $OTHER$ and $CANCEL$ are the two button labels

pkUnnamedAccount.description: Passkey window: account without a name

pkCreatedOn.description: Passkey window: creation date of a passkey; $DATE$ is formatted by the browser

bgErrNotFound.message: Login not found for this site
bgErrNotFound.description: Error: the selected login does not exist for this site

bgErrHttp.description: Error: HTTP status returned by the desktop app; $STATUS$ is the numeric code

bgErrInvalidResponse.description: Error: unexpected reply from the desktop app

bgErrCommunication.description: Error: the desktop app could not be reached

bgErrTotp.description: Error: the TOTP code could not be obtained

bgErrRpIdNotAllowed.description: Error: the passkey domain (rpId) does not match the tab

bgErrVaultUnavailable.description: Error: the RDVAULT vault cannot be reached

bgErrInsecureSender.message: Not allowed from an insecure page
bgErrInsecureSender.description: Error: request sent from a page that is not served over HTTPS

bgErrTabUrlRequired.description: Error: the tab address is missing (internal)

bgErrInsecurePage.description: Error: the page is not served over HTTPS

bgErrUnavailableOrLocked.description: Error: RDVAULT is closed, locked or busy

bgErrNameRequired.description: Error: the request does not name the secret to read

bgErrSaveCredential.description: Error: the last used login could not be remembered (internal)

bgErrReadCredential.description: Error: the last used login could not be read (internal)

bgErrClearCredential.description: Error: the last used login could not be forgotten (internal)

autofillMenuAnnounce.message: RDVAULT logins available: $COUNT$. Down Arrow to choose, Escape to close.
autofillMenuAnnounce.description: Autofill menu, read by screen readers when it opens; $COUNT$ is the number of logins listed

bgErrVaultLocked.message: RDVAULT is locked: unlock the app, then try again.
bgErrVaultLocked.description: Autofill menu error: the RDVAULT desktop app is locked

bgErrVaultClosed.message: RDVAULT is closed or unreachable: open the app, then try again.
bgErrVaultClosed.description: Autofill menu error: the RDVAULT desktop app is closed or does not answer

bgErrRateLimited.message: Too many requests sent to RDVAULT: try again in a moment.
bgErrRateLimited.description: Autofill menu error: the desktop app rate limit was reached (HTTP 429)

pkVaultUnavailable.message: RDVAULT is closed or locked: open and unlock it to continue, or use another device.
pkVaultUnavailable.description: Passkey window: RDVAULT cannot store or use a passkey because the app is closed or locked
